ownerDirectory.title: The most trusted World of Warcraft: Forever guides and addons
ownerDirectory.scopeNote: The October 18 shortlist, presented in full thematic sections with original summaries and publisher links. October 18 beta limits and reported dates are historical context, not a claim about today’s playable cap. Public pages were re-read on October 23 where stated; advertised coverage, independent testing and installed-client compatibility remain separate. “Most trusted” describes a practical shortlist, not certification or a guild endorsement of every article.

sections.title: 1. The main websites I would use
sections.intro: Start with Wowhead and Icy Veins for classes, WoW-Professions for profession routes, and Blizzard for announced rules. Add Method, Mobalytics and Warcraft Tavern for their specific authored coverage.

blocks.heading: Wowhead: named authors and review relationships
text: Wowhead’s Forever team identifies the people behind its class advice. Hunter guides name Docoda and reviewer Neteyes; Rogue names Warstry and reviewer Simonize; Warlock names Zephan, associated with Classic Warlock; Paladin names Surveillant, associated with Light Club. Those are specific relationships, not evidence that every page has independent peer review.

Its level-30 writing-team article and Babyhoof’s Fury overview are dated beta evidence. Match the recommendation to that level, patch and activity; agreement between sites can reflect the same author or model.

blocks.heading: Icy Veins: class explanations and choosing a main
text: The class directory links all nine classes and their specializations. It is useful for learning a playstyle, talent choices and rotations; read the actual author, revision and scope on the selected page. Impakt’s Beast Mastery guide is a named-author example.

The Choosing Your Main guide is an additional starting point. Profession pages are available; the older blanket “coming soon” description is obsolete. A published page still does not prove every later profession step was tested.

blocks.heading: Warcraft Tavern: additional class and system guidance
text: The October 18 shortlist includes named-author class, leveling, class-quest and system articles and the publisher’s stated editing standards. Direct article retrieval returned HTTP 403 during the October 23 public source check; no fresh article-body or editorial-policy review is claimed. Open the publisher and check each article’s evidence and date.

links.label: Affliction guide on the October 18 shortlist

blocks.heading: WoW-Professions: practical routes with explicit limits
text: Use its profession hubs for trainer locations, materials, camping and route planning. The Alchemy page still labels its beta-derived plan as work in progress and later materials as estimates. Its Artisan section must not be presented as a fully tested, price-independent route to 300.

blocks.heading: Method: nine classes, travel and available dungeon walkthroughs
text: The leveling directory links all nine classes. The dungeon directory links Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, Excavation Site: Wetlands and City of Dalaran; five additional new dungeons are listed without equivalent linked walkthroughs in the reviewed page.

Its travel article covers boats, zeppelins, trams, portals and Skyborne connections. A route outline or dungeon listing is not proof of completed endgame testing. Assess each guide directly rather than extending the publisher’s general raiding reputation.

blocks.heading: Mobalytics: identifiable creators, separate community contributions
text: Crix’s Alchemy, Engineering and Leatherworking articles provide complementary profession explanations. The October 18 review recorded October 15, 14 and 16 updates respectively; all three pages displayed October 21 revisions when re-read on October 23. Those timestamps describe the articles, not independent testing of every 1–300 step.
Separate editorial articles from user-submitted community builds. Check the particular creator, evidence and later corrections; material requirements and untested later routes remain provisional.

blocks.heading: Blizzard: announced systems and subsequent corrections
text: Use Blizzard’s Deep Dive for its descriptions of camping, Legacy, professions, rulesets and itemization. Later official notes can supersede those announcements. Specialist guides then explain practical choices; neither announcement nor datamining alone proves a tested build or an obtainable item.

sections.title: 2. Class Discords and deeper theorycrafting
sections.intro: Follow identifiable specialists and reproducible work, not a server’s reputation alone. Private Discord content and simulation spreadsheets were not independently audited.

blocks.heading: Use the documented connection, then check the actual advice
text: The October 18 shortlist points to Classic Warlock through Zephan and Light Club through Surveillant’s public writer biographies. These are leads to investigate, not proof that every message, spreadsheet or pinned build targets the current Forever build. No Discord invitation or private-content scrape is embedded here.

blocks.heading: A theorycrafting checklist
text: Confirm an explicit Forever target, game build, level and activity. Identify the maintainer and the evidence: testing, calculations, assumptions or a reproducible example. Look for later corrections.

Check whether apparently agreeing sources share an author, data extraction or model. Repetition does not make them independent confirmations. Unverified claims that all class communities publish reliable simulations earlier than websites are excluded.

sections.title: 3. Independent Forever databases and tools
sections.intro: These are supplementary references with useful source disclosures. An independent database, extracted count or automatic ranking is not a Blizzard certification or a measured final meta.

blocks.heading: The Forever Era
text: The October 18 review describes announcements, beta tables, caches, hotfix information and marked Classic-derived inputs. Use it to compare changes and investigate items or talents.

Its reviewed BiS methodology used indicative weights without simulations or scoring for procs/set bonuses and included Classic-derived acquisition assumptions. The October 23 text retrieval did not expose that methodology again, so the limitation remains attributed to the dated October 18 review; no fresh simulation validation is claimed. Check the current page before relying on its ranking.

blocks.heading: Classic WoW Forever
text: Its methodology page describes source comparison, corrections and AI-assisted work with editorial responsibility. Use its linked evidence for systems and profession changes rather than assuming extracted recipes establish an optimal leveling route.

The crafting page still displays an October 9 comparison and counts of 860 new recipes and 299 Merchant’s Favor patterns. These are dated database findings, not final availability or a Blizzard-audited launch total. Blizzard’s broader announcement of over 600 recipes has a different scope.

blocks.heading: Forever Codex
text: Its source register distinguishes client records, hotfixes, observations and Classic-derived information, including English and Spanish names. This makes it a useful additional reference when the relevant build is checked.

The accessible status page still exposes build 1.60.1.70245 and an October 8 rebuild while stating that live figures need JavaScript. That fallback does not establish every current dynamic page’s freshness, nor does it prove the whole site is stale.

sections.title: 4. In-game leveling guides and quest helpers
sections.intro: Route planners, quest trackers and paid guide packages are different products. Choose the author’s correct Forever file; the free addon, its guide module and paid coverage can have separate availability.

blocks.heading: RestedXP: evaluate the released package, not its roadmap
text: The addon is free; expanded guides are paid. Its October 9 progress report says the 1–35 routes were finished and dungeon routing was being developed. The author’s release history contains subsequent dungeon updates.

The current product roadmap separately places Forever 35–60 routes after launch, with Era routes available meanwhile; Discovery and Legacy remain planned features. A publisher’s completed-route statement is not independent testing above the old playable beta cap. Check current contents and price with the publisher; no price or exact free Forever 1–20 entitlement is promised here.

blocks.heading: Guidelime plus TUGs: separate addon and guide
text: Guidelime is the route-following addon; TUGs is a separate module. The author lists starting zones, beta-written 12–30 routes and dungeon quest guidance through Dalaran. The page retains a Classic 30–60 fallback while Forever-specific later routes await release. Free availability does not make that fallback Forever-tested.

blocks.heading: Questie: quest assistance, not a complete optimized route
text: Its releases added Forever support and subsequently added and refreshed Forever data, including Zephras Isle fixes. The blanket claim that it has only Classic data is obsolete. It remains a quest/map helper with active corrections, not proof of a finished speed-leveling route or complete coverage of every new quest.

blocks.heading: Zygor: announced coverage is not released coverage
text: The public Forever page still advertises the product as coming soon. The October 18 review also recorded a partial-launch-coverage qualification. Judge the actual available edition and entitlement before purchase; plans for Skyborne, zones, dungeons, professions and travel do not establish fully tested 1–60 or all-nine-dungeon walkthroughs.

blocks.heading: Install deliberately
text: The preserved addon catalogue below remains a dated selection of general tools and Forever-focused projects. Bag replacements, map helpers and encounter cores can overlap. Check dependencies and client flavor; publisher support is not an in-game compatibility test by Olympus.

Olympus Guild 1.3.3 is published and includes the optional website aggregate exporter. It is the preferred unified guild package. Website snapshot reporting has separate setup and availability; publication alone does not establish that the installed addon works with this website. The retired standalone Army ZIP is not a replacement recommendation, and publishing the addon does not enable website reporting.

sections.title: 5. How much confidence to place in beta guides
sections.intro: The October 18 review concerned a level-30 beta. Those historical limits explain its examples; they are not a declaration that beta is still playable today.

blocks.heading: Observed gearing advice can be useful
text: Advice based on an obtained beta item can be evidence-based. Complete level-60 loot rankings remain provisional when item discovery, hidden information and tuning are incomplete. Do not turn a useful level-30 example into a final raid-meta promise.

The October 18 review cited a developer interview about undiscovered gear. This directory does not independently certify that interview or any hidden-item model; official announcements and a guide’s actual evidence remain the references.

blocks.heading: Client records need interpretation
text: An extracted record can be real without being intended, obtainable or functioning in the current game. The October 18 review included Blizzard’s October 16 clarification that certain datamined art was not intended for Forever. That dated correction is retained in the accompanying source record; it does not disqualify all datamining.
Similarly, exact-looking recipe counts need their build, comparison method and availability limits. Never replace an unknown measurement with a Classic number or zero.

blocks.heading: Classic routes are labelled fallbacks
text: Classic geography or quest advice may help, but it does not show that new Forever quests, travel, itemization or class changes were incorporated. Keep fallback labels visible rather than presenting an old route as a verified new-game build.

blocks.heading: Seven checks before following a guide
text: Version: does it explicitly target Forever? Scope: which level and activity? Date/build: was the relevant section revised after the change? Evidence: what testing, calculation or assumption is shown? Source labels: are Classic data, estimates and unconfirmed content distinguished? Availability: is the advertised feature actually released? Authorship: who maintains and corrects it?
A narrow class-quest guide need not discuss every new system to be useful. Select for the task, inspect corrections, and keep uncertainty proportional to the evidence.

corrections.claim: Icy Veins professions are all coming soon.
corrections.treatment: Its live profession pages exist; that is separate from full tested 1–300 coverage.

corrections.claim: Method has seven classes and only two new dungeon guides.
corrections.treatment: The reviewed directory links nine classes and four new-dungeon walkthroughs. Listing all nine dungeons does not provide nine walkthroughs.

corrections.claim: RestedXP is a paid addon with every routing mode finished.
corrections.treatment: The addon is free and expanded guides are paid. Published dungeon updates and announced post-launch modes have different availability; the old exact price is not carried forward.

corrections.claim: Zygor already delivers its full announced Forever scope.
corrections.treatment: The page still marks the Forever product coming soon. The October 18 partial-launch qualification remains historical; check actual released contents.
Its author releases include Forever support, base-data additions and later corrections. Individual coverage can still be incomplete.

corrections.claim: An automatic independent BiS score establishes the best gear.
corrections.treatment: The dated October 18 review records missing simulation, proc and set-bonus scoring. Such a score is a candidate-selection aid, not a tuning or final-meta result.

corrections.claim: 860 recipes and 299 patterns are final universally verified totals.
corrections.treatment: Attribute those figures to the dated Classic WoW Forever comparison; Blizzard’s over-600 announcement measures a different stated scope. Neither establishes every recipe’s availability.

corrections.claim: Forever Codex is proven current with every beta build.
corrections.treatment: The accessible fallback still identifies70245/October8 and defers live figures to JavaScript. Check the particular current page rather than asserting universal freshness.

corrections.claim: All prelaunch gearing advice is only guessing.
corrections.treatment: Observed items can support useful advice. Unknown gear and future tuning limit complete endgame rankings; retain each recommendation’s evidence and scope.

corrections.claim: Every named source is peer-reviewed, most complete, or independently simulated.
corrections.treatment: Those blanket endorsements were not established. Follow identified authors, explicit reviewer relationships, changelogs and disclosed methods. The October 18 review also noted a sponsorship/affiliate disclosure in an older comparison; its dated judgments are not imported as independent confirmation.
